description: Defines an asynchronous utility for running tasks across multiple User Equipments (UEs) in a 3GPP-related software system, including a class template for managing concurrent coroutine execution and helper functions to initiate these tasks.

classes.name: await_all_ues_impl
classes.description: Helper class template to run a coroutine for multiple UEs and wait for all to complete.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Executes the coroutine to launch and wait for all UE tasks.

methods.name: launch_ue_tasks
methods.description: Launches asynchronous tasks for each UE to be updated.

methods.name: launch_ue_task
methods.description: Creates an async task for a specific UE to run the provided UE task factory.
